verses.en: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
verses.sm: Peteru i lona alu atu i nuu ese Ua faalogo le au aposetolo ma le au uso o i lutaia, Ierusalema, ona fefinauai le

verses.en: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.sm: ua talia e nuu ese le afioga a le Atua. Ua alu ae foi Peteru a ma ia o le au peritome,

verses.en: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
verses.sm: ua faapea mai, “Na e alu atu i tagata e le peritomeina, na outou aai foi faatasi ma i latou.”

verses.en: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
verses.sm: Ona afua lea o Peteru ona folafola faasolo ia te i latou, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
verses.sm: “O aʻu nei, sa ou tatalo i le aai o Iopa; na ou iloa le faaaliga ina ua faalia mai, o le tasi mea ua alu ifo pei se ie lautele, ua tuutuu ifo mai le lagi i ona pito e fa; ua oo lava ia te au;

verses.en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.sm: ua ou pulatoa ma manatunatu i ai, ona ou iloa atu lea o manu vaefa e tataa, ma manu feai, ma mea fetolofi, ma manu felelei.

verses.en: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
verses.sm: Na ou faalogo atu foi i le siufofoga, ua faapea mai ia te au, Peteru e, ina tu ia i luga, ina fasi, ma ʻai.

verses.en: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
verses.sm: A ua ou fai atu, Le AW e, “ana lava; auā e lei toʻia lava loʻu gutu i sina mea e ‘ai e sa, po o se mea e leaga.

verses.en: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.sm: A ua toe il tali mai ia te au le siufofoga mai le lagi, O mea ua faamamaina e le Atua, ana e te taʻua e sa.

verses.en: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.sm: Na faia faatolu lenei mea, ona toe sisi lea o mea uma lava i le lagi.

verses.en: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, sa tutu loa mai tagata e toatolu i le fale na ou i ai, na aauina ia te au mai Kaisareia.

verses.en: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
verses.sm: Na fai mai le Agaga ia te au matou te O ma i latou, aua le faailoga tagata. Na matou o foi ma le au uso nei e toaono, na matou ulu atu foi i le fale o le tagata.

verses.en: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
verses.sm: Ua na tala mai ia te i matou i lona iloa atu i le agelu na tu mai i lona fale, ma fai atu ia te ia, Ina aau atu ia ni tagata i lopa, e aami ia Simona e igoa ia Peteru;

verses.en: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
verses.sm: na te fai mai upu ia te oe, e faaolaina ai oe atoa ma lou aiga uma lava.

verses.en: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
verses.sm: Na amata ona Ou tautala atu, ona afio ifo lea o le Agaga Paia ia te i latou, faapei ona afio ifo ia te i tatou i le amataga.

verses.en: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: Ona ou manatua lea o le afioga a le Alii, ua faapea mai, Na papatiso lava Ioane i le vai, a e papatisoina outou i le Agaga Paia.

verses.en: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
verses.sm: O lenei, afai e tusa le alofa ua foaiina mai e le Atua ia te i tatou atoa ma i latou, ina ua faatuatua i le Alii o Iesu Keriso, o ai ea a‘u nei ou te mafaia ona vavao atu i le Atua?”

verses.en: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
verses.sm: Ua latou faalogo mai i ia upu, ona latou faalologo lea, ua vivii atu foi i le Atua, va faapea ane, “E moni, ua foai atu è le Atua i nuu ese le salamo e ola ai.”

verses.en: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
verses.sm: Na o atu foi e na faasalalauina i le sauaga na tupu ina ua oti o Setefano, ua oo lava i Foinie, ma Kuperu, ma Anetioka, ua le tautala atu i le upu i se tasi na o tagata Iutaia lava.

verses.en: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.sm: O tagata Kuperu ma Kurene foi nisi o i latou, ua oo foi i latou Anetioka; ua tautala i tagata Eleni, ma folafola atu le tala lelei i le AW o Iesu.

verses.en: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
verses.sm: Sa ia te i latou le aao o le Alii; ua faatuatua foi le vao tagata e toatele, ma liliu mai i le Alii.

verses.en: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
verses.sm: Ua logo atu le tala i ia mea i taliga o le ekalesia o i Ierusalema; ona latou aauina atu lea o Panapa ia oo lava i Anetioka.

verses.en: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu o ia, ma ua iloa le alofa tunoa o le Atua, ona olioli lea o ia, ma apoapoai atu ia te i latou uma lava, ia mau o latou loto ina ia pipii atu i le Alii.

verses.en: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
verses.sm: Aua o le tagata amio lelei o ia, ua tumu i le Agaga Paia ma le faatuatua; ua faaopoopoina ai foi tagata e toatele lava i le Alii.

verses.en: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
verses.sm: Ona alu lea o Panapa i Taso e saili ia Saulo.

verses.en: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
verses.sm: Ua na maua o ia, ona aumaia lea o ia i Anetioka. Ua la faatasi ma le ekalesia ua atoa le tausaga, ma aʻoaʻo atu i tagata e toatele lava; na uluai igoa foi le au soo 0 Kerisiano i Anetioka.

verses.en: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
verses.sm: O ona po ia na o ifo ai perofeta mai Ierusalema i Anetioka.

verses.en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
verses.sm: Na tu iluga foi le tasi o i latou, o Akapo le igoa, na faailoa e ia mai le Agaga le oge tele o le a tupu i le lalolagi uma; sa taunuu ai foi i le nofoaiga a Kalaotio.

verses.en: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
verses.sm: Ona filifili lea taitoatasi o le au soo, ia faatatau i mea ua manuia ai, E avatu ai se alofa i le au uso o nonofo i Iutaia;

verses.en: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
